metadata.title: Astrobiological Bayesian Network Prior Parameters for K2-18b
metadata.author: Daniel Rivero Losa
metadata.institution: Universidad Antonio de Nebrija — Escuela Politécnica Superior

X0_Stellar_M.description: Host Star Classification: Active M2.5V dwarf star
X0_Stellar_M.astrophysical_justification: K2-18 is an established M2.5V dwarf (M_* = 0.495 M_sun, T_eff = 3457 K) with high prior certainty (Benneke et al. 2019).

X1_Orbit_HZ.description: Orbital Habitable Zone: Semi-major axis a = 0.1429 AU within conservative liquid water zone
X1_Orbit_HZ.astrophysical_justification: Insolation S = 1368 W/m^2 (comparable to Earth's flux), placing the orbit in the conservative liquid water zone.

X2_Hycean.description: Planetary Structural Regime: Hycean sub-Neptune (massive H2 envelope over global ocean mantle)
X2_Hycean.astrophysical_justification: Bulk density rho = 2.67 g/cm^3 matches hydrogen-rich mantle solutions under moderate stellar irradiation (Madhusudhan et al. 2023).

X3_Bio_Ocean.description: Marine Biosphere: Ocean mantle sustaining active geochemical and biological recycling
X3_Bio_Ocean.astrophysical_justification: Habitable Hycean conditions permit metabolic marine biospheres with substantial probability.

X4_CH4.description: Atmospheric Methane: Significant spectroscopic absorption (>5 sigma detection)
X4_CH4.astrophysical_justification: JWST NIRSpec/NIRISS confirmed CH4 at 1.4, 2.3, and 3.3 um with >5 sigma confidence (Madhusudhan et al. 2023).

X5_CO2.description: Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide: Spectral absorption at 2.7 and 4.3 um (~3 sigma detection)
X5_CO2.astrophysical_justification: CO2 detected by JWST at ~3 sigma; photochemical byproduct of atmospheric CO/CO2 chemistry.

X6_H2O.description: Tropospheric Water Vapor: Absorption at 1.4 um
X6_H2O.astrophysical_justification: Hubble WFC3 and JWST data constrain tropospheric water vapor presence in the habitable zone (Benneke et al. 2019).

X7_DMS.astrophysical_justification: DMS on Earth is biogenic; abiotic false positives are constrained to 10^-4.

X8_CFC.astrophysical_justification: Zero abiotic production pathways exist for CFC-12. Prior calibrated to enforce marginal prior P(X8=1) = 1.0e-6 (Lin et al. 2014, Haqq-Misra et al. 2022).
